cv.name: Selin Demir
cv.headline: Consultant | Life Sciences | Data & Analytics
cv.summary: Consultant in life sciences with a background in data analysis. I started in a pharma services company building reports and SQL pipelines, and now work on commercial and operations projects for pharma clients, where I still do much of the analytical work myself.

experience.title: Consultant, Life Sciences Practice
bullets: Supported a launch readiness assessment for a mid-sized biotech entering three European markets
Built the market sizing and patient flow model used in the client's investment decision
Ran interviews with 20 key account managers to map the current sales process
Prepared steering committee materials in English and German

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Wrote SQL and Python pipelines for clinical supply and sales data
Built Tableau dashboards used by 60 people in supply planning
Automated the monthly KPI report, saving about two days of work per month

skills: Pharma commercial and supply chain processes
